name: Screensaver
description: Idle screensaver for Push 3. After a configurable idle timeout it takes over the display with an animation (Rainbow / Plasma / Starfield); any pad/button/encoder wakes it. Configured on-device via push-manager's Shadow UI (SCREENSAVER tab). REQUIRES push-manager + push-display installed and running (it draws through push-manager's display API).
author: rave
